The '''MD-series medical droid''' was a line of [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. The MD medical specialists were a common sight throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and while not as advanced as the 2-1B, the MDs were highly respected on medical centers of less-civilized [[Planet/Legends|planets]], where their low cost and high levels of specialization on specific medical fields were a big help for local physicians. They were also liked for their lower prices, as a standard unit would normally cost around 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

==Description==
MD-series [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] had a similar body style to [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droids]] owing to the fact that they were both produced by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. MD units featured more [[Human/Legends|Human]]-like as well as an insulated sheath that protected the droid's internal mechanisms. They were more dependent on connections to mainframe [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and did not operate as effectively outside of a medical facility.<ref name="EGTD" />

Industrial Automaton produced ten distinct MD models, each one performing a specialized role and equipped with speciality attachments. [[MD-0 medical droid|MD-0s]] were diagnostic units, [[MD-1 medical droid|MD-1s]] served as [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] technicians, [[MD-2 medical droid|MD-2s]] worked as anaesthesiologists, [[MD-3 medical droid|MD-3s]] were pharmacists, and [[MD-4 medical droid|MD-4s]] were micorsurgery specialists. The most popular model was the [[MD-5 medical droid|MD-5]], which acted as a general practitioner.<ref name="EGTD" />

The [[MD-6 medical droid|MD-6]] was produced exclusively for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], while [[MD-7 medical droid|MD-7s]] were experts in emergency trauma. [[MD-8 medical droid|MD-8s]] and [[MD-9 medical droid|9s]] were prototypes released in limited numbers, while [[MD-10 medical droid|MD-10s]], the most recent version, were each a specialist in a certain field.<ref name="EGTD" />

==History==
[[File:MD-seriesdroid-FF96.png|thumb|right|150px|An MD-series medical droid]]
Manufactured by Industrial Automaton, the MD-series were not the most advanced medical droids on the market but they were by far the most common. They were introduced [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and new units were still produced daily on the [[Factory/Legends|factory]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Telti/Legends|Telti]] well into the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGTD" />

The MD-series was cheaper than other medical droid models, making it a popular choice for medical facilities on less civilized outposts, or those working under budget constraints. Practicing [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]] commonly used MD droids to assist them with medical procedures. Due to the fact that the droids very rarely left [[Medical bay/Legends|medical bays]], they did not require a lot of maintenance and if proper care was provided they could last for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].<ref name="AEG" />
